name: Sheraton Rhodes Resort
insider_take: Where ancient mythology meets modern luxury on Greece's most storied island.
whats_special: This resort sits on the legendary island where the Colossus of Rhodes once stood - one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The hotel's beachfront location offers direct access to the crystal-clear Aegean waters, while Rhodes Old Town (a UNESCO World Heritage site) is just minutes away with its medieval fortress walls and cobblestone streets that have witnessed 2,400 years of history.
pro_tip: Visit the nearby Valley of the Butterflies (Petaloudes) during summer months when thousands of Jersey Tiger moths create a magical natural spectacle - it's only a 20-minute drive from the resort.
dont_miss: The Palace of the Grand Master of the Knights of Rhodes, where you can walk through rooms once occupied by medieval knights, and catch sunset from Monte Smith Hill where the ancient Acropolis ruins offer panoramic views over three seas meeting at Rhodes' northern tip.
pros: Prime beachfront location with direct access to beautiful Mediterranean beaches
Comprehensive resort amenities including multiple pools, spa, and fitness facilities
Multiple dining options with Greek and international cuisine
Excellent location for exploring Rhodes' ancient city and historical attractions
cons: Large resort property may feel less intimate for some guests
Popular tourist area can be crowded during peak season
